top_signals.title: Stock Futures Rally as AI Trade Gathers Pace; EU Budget Talks Falter
top_signals.summary: US investors return from the holiday with a rally in equity futures as a tech recovery gains momentum. EU leaders cut budget talks short after failing to negotiate a long-term funding plan. Shoppers prepare for Black Friday as retailers navigate higher fuel costs and consumers tightening their belts. Marija Veitmane of State Street joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss the stock rebound, and Nadia Martin Wiggen of Svelland Capital takes a look at the oil market as attacks in the Middle East escalates. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Japan releases new guidelines on use of AI by Self-Defense Forces
top_signals.summary: The new guidelines build on the Defense Ministry's basic policy for promoting the use of artificial intelligence, released in 2024.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: ¿Volverá la derecha al poder en España?
top_signals.summary: España vota tras casi tres años de enorme tensión. Las encuestas apuntan a un regreso de la derecha, pero en 2023 también lo hicieron y Pedro Sánchez logró mantenerse en el poder. ¿Qué está en juego esta vez? (Source: Bloomberg)
